mizutani: Ghazni, on the Kabul–Kandahar trunk road
basis: Vivien, Cunningham, Beal, Majumdar (Stein), Mizutani; Watters: old Zabal near Ghazni (tentative); route best-fit (both texts) takes Ghazni for 12.01; no site evidence; Foucher II p. 235: geographically uncertain (his Jaguda is the upper Arghandab); Pelliot (II p. 240 n. 35): phonetically unresolved, Tang shu calls the second capital A-so-ni; name hardly fits: *γak-s-na, voiceless s for z and an unexplained -k (data/names/); rests on the route and the Tang shu

mizutani: Andarāb, the Doshi river valley W of the Khawak pass
basis: Vivien, Cunningham, Beal, Watters, Mizutani; Life: 3 Mahāsāṃghika monasteries, Aśoka stūpa; leg to Khost 29 km for 400 li (DIST), a figure problem; no site evidence; Foucher I pp. 22, 136: capital on the alluvial plateau E of the governor's house at Banu (pebble substructures, old coins, 14-15 li); Kishnabad spur only a qaleh; Bactr. Andar (BDNA II p. 192) is a different district (data/names/bactrian.tsv)

mizutani: the Pamir system
basis: Beal, Mizutani; Watters: Bolor Tagh and Karakoram (wider); region, nothing to test

mizutani: Badakhshan
basis: Vivien, Cunningham, Beal, Watters, Mizutani; direct name match; route legs fit (z +0.1, 0.0); no site evidence

mizutani: Kuran (Karan) river valley, upper Kokcha
basis: Beal, Watters (Yule), Mizutani; Vivien's Garana = same lapis district; 新唐書 倶蘭; leg from Yamgān fits (z −0.07)

mizutani: Khandūd, S bank of the Ab-i-Panja, Wakhan
basis: Vivien (Kandat), Mizutani (Ḥudūd al-ʿĀlam, Stein Serindia I pp. 60-71); name survives; no site evidence; characters fit Khamdādh (Ḥudūd §26.15, idol-temples of the Vakhis) (data/names/)

mizutani: Shighnān, N of Wakhan
basis: Julien, Vivien, Beal, Watters, Mizutani; 新唐書 識匿; hearsay country

mizutani: Chitral and Mastuj region
basis: Vivien, Beal (tentative), Watters (accepted with reservations), Mizutani; onward leg to Pamir valley fits (z +0.2); hearsay country

mizutani: Pamir river valley between Alichur and Wakhan ranges
basis: Vivien, Beal, Mizutani; Watters doubts Curzon's Great Pamir without a rival; legs 200 km (z +0.4) and 182 km (z +0.9)

mizutani: Lake Victoria (Zor-Kul, Sar-i-Köl)
basis: Vivien (Wood), Beal, Dey, Mizutani; Watters doubts Curzon; text's 300 × 50 li not usable

mizutani: Qiz-qurghan, ruined rock fortress on the Taghdumbash Pamir
basis: Stein, On Ancient Central-Asian Tracks p. 47 (via Mizutani): standing rock fortress locally called 'princess's tower', matching the legend; Beal: name Tash Kurghan (tentative); legend/local name only; no measurements

mizutani: Kashgar
basis: Vivien, Cunningham, Beal, Watters, Dey, Mizutani; text glosses old 疏勒 as the capital; no site evidence in these sources

mizutani: Khotan
basis: all authorities; text glosses 于闐 and 渙那 (Khot. hvaṃna, Kharoṣṭhī khotaṃna); Stein at Yotkan (12.22a); leg from Karghalik fits (z +0.2)

mizutani: Chalma-kazān ruins, 13 miles SSE of Yotkan
proposed: Chalma-kazān (on the name only); site open
basis: Thomas, Stein Ancient Khotan pp. 231-35 (Chalma < Tib. Tsar-ma = 贊摩寺); text 10余里 S (c. 3 km) vs c. 21 km: distance c. 7× too long, not discussed by Mizutani

mizutani: Kohmāri Hill, 11 miles SSW of Yotkan
basis: Thomas (Tib. ri Glan-ru), Stein Ancient Khotan pp. 185, 188, Dey, Mizutani; bearing fits, 20 li (c. 6 km) vs c. 17 km

mizutani: Bowa-Kambar ruins, c. 4 miles SW of Yotkan
basis: Stein Ancient Khotan p. 225 via Mizutani; distance and bearing fit (c. 6 km SW for 10余里); no name or find

mizutani: Kum-rabāt-Pādshāhim Mazār (Kaptar-Mazār), 16 miles E of Piālma
basis: Stein Ancient Khotan pp. 119ff via Mizutani; c. 35 km WNW of Yotkan for 150-160 li, consistent with 12.22.06; only proposal

mizutani: Somiya village, c. 1 mile W of Yōtkan
basis: Thomas (Tib. So-ma-ña), Stein Ancient Khotan pp. 223-25 (stūpa in Somiya cemetery), Dey; name survives; 5-6 li W fits

mizutani: Kum-i-Shahidān shrine, c. 1 mile SE of Yōtkan
basis: Thomas (Tib. ma-ża), Stein Ancient Khotan p. 230 via Mizutani; 5-6 li SE fits; no name or find at the shrine

mizutani: Naghara-khāna mound by the Aiding-kul pond SE of Yōtkan
basis: Stein Ancient Khotan pp. 226-27, Adachi, Hori via Mizutani; c. 4 km SE (drum hung SE of the city); local name 'drum-house'

mizutani: Krorayina, i.e. Loulan
basis: Thomas & Konow, Konow (Khot. raurata) via Mizutani; name equation only; legend city, hearsay; Beal restorations only

mizutani: the Niya site 65 miles N of Niya Bazar
basis: Kharoṣṭhī documents from the site name nina (Boyer, Rapson et al. pp. 324-25, 353); Stein; Watters (Hedin); leg to Endere fits; 200 li from 媲摩 vs 185 km is a 12.22.12 problem

mizutani: Endere ruins
basis: Stein Ancient Khotan pp. 417ff (excavated), Smith in Watters, Mizutani; 400 li E of Niya = 103 km is a calibration leg; nothing ties the site to the name

mizutani: Loulan/Shanshan region = Tib. Nob, modern Lop (Mirān, Charkhlik)
basis: text: 即樓蘭地也; Vivien, Beal, Watters, Mizutani; Stein Serindia I pp. 318ff, Huang Wenbi (Lop sites); leg from Charchan fits (z +0.2)

mizutani: Yōtkan, c. 5 miles W of modern Khotan
basis: Stein Ancient Khotan pp. 190ff, Dey, Mizutani; distances to Somiya, Kum-i-Shahidān, Bowa-Kambar fit Yōtkan as centre; Ji 1985 p. 1010 reports Huang Wenbi's Shisbir; it does not fit the distances to Somiya etc.
